6277-6797-7084.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
On Wings of Gold triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

2707-4872-5496.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Tomb Trawler by paying {2}, causing you to put Time Warp on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Warp from the bottom of your library due to River Song during your draw step.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2011-3259-8201.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2011-3259-8201.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Najeela as attackers.
Najeela triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
2011-3259-8201.notes: If you attack with Warrior(s), you can get infinite creature tokens from Najeela's triggered ability.

891-1703-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Fool's Demise's first and second ability triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Fool's Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the second Fool's Demise ability, doing nothing,.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1978-5116-7280.description:
Animate Gilded Lotus using Donatello.
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Repeat from step 2.

1409-3129-5419.description:
Activate Kalain by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Kalain enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Kalain.
Resolve the Kalain trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

997-5310-7084.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Bloodghast
When Bloodghast dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning Bloodghast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

562-2906-7070.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost at least 2 life this turn.
562-2906-7070.description:
Activate Warrior en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Warrior en-Kor.
The Warrior en-Kor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Warrior en-Kor from exile by paying {0} due to Rakdos.
Repeat.

147-5147-6817.description:
Cast Presumed Dead by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Presumed Dead, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Presumed Dead.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Goblin Bombardment abilities from step 5.

229-1793-5220.description:
Cast Endless One by paying {0}.
Endless One enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Mortuary and Harvester of Souls.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Endless One from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Harvester of Souls trigger, causing you to draw a card, thus drawing Endless One from your library.
Repeat.

513-527-1115.notablePrerequisites:
You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using only colored mana.
Selvala can tap to produce at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast the other creature card.
513-527-1115.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast a creature card from your hand.
Cast a creature card by paying its mana cost.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying {1}{G}{G}.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning the creature cast in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2512-4594-6562.description:
Cast Daru Spiritualist by paying {1}{W}.
When Daru Spiritualist enters the battlefield, Jaws of Defeat triggers.
Holding priority, activate Spirit en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting Daru Spiritualist.
Daru Spiritualist triggers, giving it +0/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve the Spirit en-Kor ability.
Repeat from step 3 an arbitrarily large number of times.
Resolve the Jaws of Defeat trigger, causing an opponent to lose an arbitrarily large amount of life.

880-3534-3875.notablePrerequisites:
You control seven or more lands with different names.
You control an additional creature.
880-3534-3875.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield Tireless Provisioner and Field of the Dead trigger.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Field of the Dead trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

719-1445-2060-6413.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
719-1445-2060-6413.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card.
Green Goblin's first ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Tortured Existence ability, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1329-2178-3661-4779.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-2178-3661-4779.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Shield Sphere from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shield Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Shield Sphere.
When Shield Sphere dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat.

4053-5686-5944.notablePrerequisites: Unstoppable Slasher does not have a counter on it.
4053-5686-5944.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Unstoppable Slasher.
When Unstoppable Slasher dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with zero stun counters due to Solemnity.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-586-2511-5258-5618.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {3}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

4499-4747-5223.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Alena.
Activate Alena by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may blink any other creature(s) you control.

647-3259-4302-4875.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to any other creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
"Angel" chosen with Conspiracy.
647-3259-4302-4875.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to any other creature you control, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
When the creature that had Breath of Fury attached dies as an Angel due to Conspiracy, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Conspiracy, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat each combat phase.

1636-2857-3122.notablePrerequisites:
Adarkar Valkyrie does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one legendary creature.
1636-2857-3122.description:
Activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting any legendary creature you control.
Cast Undercover Operative by paying {2}{U}{U}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of the legendary creature targeted in step 1.
Put the legendary creature into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Adarkar Valkyrie and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Holding priority, activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting Undercover Operative.
Resolve the Adarkar Valkyrie trigger from step 4, returning the legendary creature to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Put Undercover Operative into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Adarkar Valkyrie and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Holding priority, activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting the legendary creature.
Resolve the Adarkar Valkyrie trigger from step 9, returning Undercover Operative to the battlefield from your graveyard as a copy of the legendary creature.
Repeat from step 3.

1124-1636-2034-3323-4091.notablePrerequisites: Aphetto Alchemist does not have summoning sickness.
1124-1636-2034-3323-4091.description:
Activate Tevesh Szat's first loyalty ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, creating two 0/1 Thrull creature tokens.
When the Thrulls enter the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping all creatures.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, untapping The Chain Veil.
Resolve the second Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, untapping target artifact or creature.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two Thrull tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate The Chain Veil by paying {4} and tapping it, allowing you an additional activation of your planeswalkers' loyalty abilities this turn.
Repeat.

2097-2816-4659-5309.notablePrerequisites:
Umbral Mantle attached to Black Market Tycoon.
Black Market Tycoon does not have summoning sickness.
2097-2816-4659-5309.description:
Activate Black Market Tycoon by tapping it, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing both Treasure tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Black Market Tycoon by paying {3} and untapping it, giving itself +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.
